description: Check whether a date is a business day in Japan, and if not, why (weekend, holiday name, bank closure, or a custom closed day). `reason` is Japanese text; `reason_code` is one of weekend, holiday, bank_closure, extra_holiday (null on business days). flags: `estimated`/`unverified` when the year's holidays are an estimate. / その日が営業日かどうかと、休みの理由（土日・祝日の名前・銀行の休業日・指定された休日）。reason_code は weekend・holiday・bank_closure・extra_holiday。

calendar.description: "standard": weekends and national holidays are closed. "bank": also closed Dec 31 - Jan 3 (Japanese bank holidays). / standard：土日・祝日が休み。bank：加えて12月31日〜1月3日が休み（銀行の休業日）

extra_business_days.description: Days treated as business days even if they are weekends or holidays. / 休日でも営業日とする日

extra_holidays.description: Additional company-specific closed days (e.g. summer break). / 会社独自の休み

name: check_business_day
title: Check a business day / 営業日かどうかの判定
